Consider the square region $Δ$ in the $uv$-plane, given by

$$
Δ={(u,v)\,:\,1\le u\le \sqrt{2},\,\,\frac{\pi }{6}\le v\le \frac{\pi }{3}},
$$

and the transformation $T,$ given by

$$
T:(u,v)\to (u\operatorname{cos}⁡v,\,u\operatorname{sin}⁡v).
$$

The image of the bottom side of $Δ$ under the action of $T$ is a line segment. Which of the following statements are true regarding the image?

- The image makes the angle of $\frac{\pi }{6}$ with the positive $x$-axis.
- The image makes the angle of $\frac{\pi }{3}$ with the positive $x$-axis.
- The endpoints of the image lie on the circles of radii $1$ and $2$ centered at $O.$
